cross_cutting_problems.detail: Some pages indexed as 'www.sealines.eu', others as bare 'sealines.eu' (e.g., sealines.eu/index.php/compagnie/jadrolinija, sealines.eu/index.php/traghetti-sardegna). Incomplete www canonicalization.

Facebook: facebook.com/sealines.it (.it not .eu). Instagram: @traghetti.sealines (1,204 followers). No verified Twitter/X account found. LinkedIn 'Sea Lines' appears to be a different Turkish company. Any sameAs URLs in schema markup may point to wrong profiles.

All direct HTTP requests return 403 Forbidden with 'host_not_allowed'. While this specific 403 was from the sandboxed environment's proxy, if the site uses aggressive WAF rules, it could block legitimate crawlers, SEO audit tools, and social media preview bots (affecting Open Graph/Twitter Card rendering).
Pages like /chi-siamo and /contatti have '2025' in titles. These are evergreen pages where year is inappropriate and creates annual maintenance burden.

Google still indexes 2024-dated pages: /traghetti-grecia-isole (Partenze 2024), /ferries-croatia-jadrolinija-departures-2024, /traghetti-sardegna-moby-tirrenia-2024. These zombie pages compete with current versions.
